ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated on the distal regions and 60% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated centrally and along the leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patch located on the distal half of the left lobe. Fine white streaks and mottled feathering radiating from the central axis toward the trailing edge of the right lobe. Dominant low-intensity black pigmentation in the proximal regions near the peduncle and surrounding the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence; estimated interior angle of 45 degrees relative to the horizontal lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; distinct peaks and valleys are clearly visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, with greater amplitude on the distal portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve beginning at the distal tips, transitioning into a pronounced concave sweep toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (0.5-1% fluke area) distributed within the central dark regions of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of diagonal and vertical linear white marks (rake scars) intersecting the white patch on the left lobe and the mottled streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent cluster of vertical white scars at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe; small irregular notch at the distal outer edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Radial pigmentation pattern on the right lobe where white pixels form distinct 'fingers' or streaks pointing toward the trailing edge.
